dorsal_planar_contour_and_symmetry.axial_tapering: Gradual geometric narrowing from the maximum width at the mid-section toward the anterior rostrum; posterior tapering is visible until the peduncle region is obscured by water turbulence.
dorsal_planar_contour_and_symmetry.planar_edge_undulation: Mainly smooth lateral margins; a minor asymmetrical bulge is visible on the left lateral edge relative to the right.

surface_reflectance_and_textural_phase.global_grayscale_baseline: Medium-grey skin tone across the dorsal plane; distinct lateral shading on the right side increases toward the water interface.
surface_reflectance_and_textural_phase.transition_boundaries: Diffuse gradient between the central light-grey dorsal region and the darker lateral-right shading.

high_frequency_epidermal_anomalies.localized_point_contrast_disruptions: Presence of a high-contrast dark circular point on the anterior midline and several faint, parallel linear marks on the lower-left dorsal quadrant.

acquired_anomalies_or_scars: Faint, light-colored linear striations (rake marks) on the posterior-left dorsal surface.
other_distinctive_markers: Single high-intensity white specular highlight on the anterior midline of the head region.
